Telangana warns of power, water crisis due to El Niño

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has warned of a potential power and water crisis in the state, attributing the threat to the impact of El Niño. Reports suggest the state may have failed to conserve water and secure adequate coal reserves despite expert warnings about the El Niño-induced crisis.
